repos_data.description: Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & Cursor — the Meta node of Pipeboard’s 5-platform family (+ Google, TikTok, Snap, Reddit). Hosted remote MCP, badged Meta Business Partner, free plan — no self-hosting required.
MCP server for Meta Marketing API v25.0 — 135 tools for Facebook & Instagram ad campaign management
Your local-first AI ad ops crew. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex & Gemini.

Open-source MCP server for AI agents: read across 43 ad platforms, with verified write and create across 16 core platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, TikTok, X, Amazon, TTD, DV360, StackAdapt & more). Free reads (zsh/mo), /mo Solo for writes, multi-tenant OAuth & REST/SDKs.

MCP server for Google Ad Manager. Manage ad campaigns, orders, line items, and creatives through AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and VS Code. Automate your ad operations with natural language instead of clicking through the GAM UI. Built by Matious.
MCP server for the VK Ads API: manage campaigns, ad groups, ads, bids and statistics from Claude, Cursor, Codex
MCP server for the Yandex Direct API: manage PPC campaigns, ads, keywords and negative keywords, bids and bid modifiers, and statistics from Claude, Cursor, Codex
AdsAgent hosted MCP for Meta, Google Ads & TikTok — public Chatgpt/Claude/Cursor/Grok skill pack + install URLs (Model Context Protocol).
MCP server for the Reddit Ads API v3: working write operations, tiered safety controls, and built-in OAuth setup.
MCP server for the Avito Ads API: analyze campaigns, change group budgets and bids, manage users and ORD contracts from an AI app
MCP server for Yandex Audience: create CRM and lookalike segments, manage pixels and access from an AI app
